atads.source: FAA Air Traffic Activity System (ATADS), Airport Operations, Standard Report (tower operations counted by FAA and contract towers)
atads.query: report server https://www.aspm.faa.gov/opsnet/sys/opsnet-server-x.asp, command air_bas, calendar years 2024 and 2025, facilities ACY MHT BOS PHL PGD, all days, IFR + VFR itinerant and local columns (the same table the Airport.asp form returns)
atads.http: POST 200 for 2024 and 2025 (aspm.faa.gov answers 301 to www.aspm.faa.gov)
atads.note: ATADS 'AirCarrier' = scheduled large carrier operations, 'AirTaxi' = commuter / on-demand, 'GeneralAviation' and 'Military' as reported. itinerant = IFR + VFR itinerant; local = operations by aircraft that stay in the local area (pattern work, practice), civil and military.

uk.source: UK Civil Aviation Authority, UK Airport Data 2025, Table 03.1 Aircraft Movements (annual 2025)
uk.note: Heathrow Airport Limited publishes the same totals on its traffic pages; the CAA table is the official return.
